prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original hand-painted HUD icon for a 2D industrial mining fantasy action game, one single icon on genuine transparent alpha.
Style: refined original hand-painted game art, softly painted bevels, charcoal-gray steel and aged dark copper with mineral focal color, sophisticated restrained highlights. Readable at 24 to 32 pixels. Exactly two to three large bold shape groups; no delicate microdetail. Use fully SOLID OPAQUE RGB-painted surfaces for the entire subject, including dark steel, copper, and crystals. Alpha transparency ONLY outside the silhouette and in genuine holes; never fade dark painted parts to transparent. Avoid black material, use visible medium charcoal-gray and warm mid-tone copper.
Composition: single centered icon, square canvas, full object and wide transparent margins (18 percent on all sides), no surrounding panel, circle, badge or frame.
Constraints: no text, no numbers, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no scene, no floor, no drop shadow, no background glow, no glossy candy mobilegame rendering, no existing-franchise motifs.
Subject: ENERGY RESOURCE. A short, wide industrial power cell, charcoal-gray body with two broad cyan-and-pale-yellow chevron inlays facing right, an unmistakable double-arrow / fast-charge silhouette. One chunky copper terminal at each short end, only three primary shape groups. The double arrow is broad and horizontal and integrated into the cell, NOT branching lightning or a thin zig-zag. Matte turquoise mineral inlay with one restrained pale yellow edge, readable at small HUD size. No lettering or battery meter lines.

qa.visual: Pass: distinct icon silhouette, hand-painted mining material, no text, no badge.

alpha_scan.note: Strict transparent_background_verified requires every border pixel exactly zero; a false result may indicate faint generator residuals. Preserve original generated pixels and inspect border_max_alpha; no code cleanup performed.
